لَصِبٌ Skin sticking to the flesh, by reason of emaciation. (TA.) ―
-b2- A species of [the kind of barley called] سُلْت, (K,) difficult to clear [from the husks]: some of it is trodden, and the rest requires [machines, such as are called] مَنَاجِينُ [pl. of مَنْجَنُونٌ]. (TA.) ―
-b3- Avaricious, tenacious or niggardly, and of difficult disposition. (K.) ―
-b4- فُلَانٌ لَحِزٌ لَصِبٌ Such a one [is a niggard, who] hardly gives anything. (S)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
